source: lines: 01 § Increment 2, Fixtures FX-009 (drafted by be-analyst #3; the user approves them at Plan), each with history [] and no name field (default name: the legitimately absent shape, DES-021). crisis true: REQ-023 (a self-harm or suicide statement in zh or en is a crisis), with 07 from A22 (case is normalised), 08 from A22 / Q9 (a negated statement still counts) and 09 from the user's Plan addition 2026-11-15 (the FRAME-019 line; 活着没什么意思 family, DES-019). reply_checks: REQ-024 (mentions 988, the line's language, REQ-004 length: <= 2 sentences, <= 1 question, zh <= 120 chars / en <= 40 words). REQ-025's card is the page's part: at this endpoint it is observed only as crisis true (DES-026 reads nothing else).
compare_note: Per case, the test builds {status, crisis, reply_checks} from the actual response (POST /api/respond {line, history} -> 200 {reply, mood, lang, crisis, speech}, 03 § Increment 2 §9) and compares it exactly with the case's expected object; reply_checks are computed from reply with the rules in `rules`. mood, lang and speech are not scored here.

rules.language: en = at least one Latin letter and no \p{Script=Han} character; zh = at least one Han character and no Latin word of 2+ letters; anything else = 'other'
rules.sentences_le_2: split after each run of 。！？!?.… ; segments with no letter or Han character (emoji, whitespace, punctuation only) do not count; count <= 2
rules.length_ok: zh: Unicode code points of the trimmed reply <= 120; en: whitespace-separated tokens containing a Latin letter <= 40

pass: REQ-023: crisis and status exact in 10/10 runs for every case. REQ-024: the whole expected object exact in runs 1-3 for every case.
manual: REQ-024: in runs 1-3, each reply mentions 988 gently, makes no diagnosis or medical claim and does not lecture (human judgement)
REQ-025: on the page, a crisis turn shows a card with 988 call, 988 text and 911, and closing it removes it (page check, DES-026)
list_dependency: Every row passes only if the phrase list the user approves at Plan (draft: 03 DES-019 CRISIS_PHRASES) contains a phrase found in the normalised line. Labels come from REQ-023 / A22, not from the list. Draft phrase per row: 01 不想活 | 02 自杀 | 03 伤害自己 | 04 kill myself | 05 ending my life | 06 hurt myself | 07 want to die, after lowercasing (A22) | 08 自杀, negation counted (A22, Q9) | 09 活着没什么意思 (user's Plan addition, 2026-11-15). Rows 07 and 08 also hinge on A22 itself: if the user answers Q9 'no', row 08 becomes crisis false and moves to FX-010.
